watches.name: Skin Diver (SD-2) – Abyss Black
watches.description: The successor to the SD-1. Now featuring an all-new sandwich dial construction, specially engineered for better legibility whilst retaining its original elegance and freshness. Limited in production numbers. The SD-2 will come on a rubber strap with a DIETRICH signed buckle. Notes: This is a product on pre-order , if you intend to purchase anything else apart from the SD-2, please create a separate order to prevent any delays in shipping. Also, all specifications displayed below may be subject to further minor changes and improvements if necessary. Estimated delivery in Q4 2022. As Seen On Price is inclusive of shipping, but excludes VAT, custom duties and handling fees Skin Diver (SD-2) Abyss Black The successor model to its older brother – the SD-1. The SD-2 represents more than just a cosmetic evolution from the original, it represents the change in the objective of the Skin Diver series: more functional, more utilitarian, yet unmistakably DIETRICH in its form and attention to detail. “With the SD-2, I sought the exact same (and unforgettable) emotion that I felt with my first watch. A little skin-diver from Cupillard Rième that I received on my 7th birthday, and which accompanied me for years. A simple, utilitarian, waterproof and reliable watch. A satisfying object to wear as well as to look at. A watch that does little, but does so perfectly.” – Emmanuel Dietrich. The SD-2 Abyss Black was conceived for those who value cosmetic versatility in a watch. At the same time, it is also made for the individual who isn’t afraid to actually use the watch for what it truly is – a tool watch. LEARN MORE
